name: Solver convergence
description: Release-level LSODA convergence study for the frozen Baja reference trajectory, including continuous-state, hybrid-sequence, event-time, regime-history, absolute-tolerance, and computational-cost diagnostics.
interpretation_boundaries: The tight reference is a numerical reference solution, not an analytical exact solution.
Native solve_ivp points are reported only as a transparent cost proxy; they are not called function evaluations.
A close final state is not sufficient for hybrid convergence if the transition signature or regime history differs.
A coarsest passing grid point is descriptive and does not automatically replace solver settings used by other frozen studies.
